title: One-page briefing
purpose: Summarize need, source evidence, caveats, and responsible next steps.
whoFor: Donors, campus groups, advisors, and partners
safetyNote: Review sources and caveats before external circulation.

title: Workshop agenda
purpose: Plan a structured learning session with source review and safeguards.
whoFor: Teachers, facilitators, universities, and civic groups
safetyNote: Facilitation should be trauma-aware and human-reviewed.

title: Responsible action plan
purpose: Translate learning into a next step through reviewed organizations and safeguards.
whoFor: Teams, donors, student groups, and community leaders
safetyNote: Do not route support to unreviewed organizations.

title: Donor checklist
purpose: Compare evidence, official channels, caveats, and review status before support.
safetyNote: This is not an endorsement or ranking tool.

title: Partner intake questions
purpose: Prepare questions for reviewed partners before offering time, money, data, or tools.
safetyNote: Do not collect sensitive data before partner review.

title: Technology risk checklist
purpose: Identify privacy, location, data, and deployment risks before building a tool.
safetyNote: No sensitive data collection or beneficiary identification.

title: Capacity gap memo
purpose: Document a capacity gap hypothesis, evidence, competencies, and review needs.
whoFor: Humanitarian advisors, universities, and program teams
safetyNote: Capacity gaps require human review and local validation.

title: Scenario preparedness checklist
purpose: Turn assumptions into preparedness questions without making predictions.
safetyNote: Use scenarios as assumptions, not forecasts.

title: Campus dialogue guide
purpose: Prepare a structured, trauma-aware campus learning conversation.
safetyNote: Do not force dialogue or flatten grief.

title: Youth leadership project plan
purpose: Design a partner-mediated youth leadership project with safeguarding.
safetyNote: No direct unsupervised contact with minors or vulnerable people.
